title: Tweaked Pains
description: Retextures prototype pain moodles to be more inline with vanilla ui resolution
body:
A simple resource pack that retextures [prototype pain](https://modrinth.com/mod/prototype-pain) moodles to be more inline with vanilla minecraft ui/hud resolution!

![New moodle textures listed in the following order from left to right: Bleeding, Blood loss, Pain, Low Oxygen, Low Consciousness, Low Temperature, Adrenaline, Amputated, Jaw gone, Hearing loss](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9c8bff478a8dab5dc19cd21dd40f500b5b6ba348.png)
